decisions.reason: After three years with only a brief mention and no further archived presence, its option value appears low and unlikely to justify continued commitment.
The dedicated lift line has shown no ongoing market presence or updates, suggesting its uncertain prospects have resolved negatively.
The building material lift has not demonstrated traction or continued promotion, making its value as an option unlikely to be realized.
The truck-mounted furniture lift is a further niche variant with no evidence of sustained demand, indicating the option should be abandoned.
